sourceFindings.area: Merged journal reads and privacy mutation
sourceFindings.result: Automatic merge retains D1 batch reads, bound user/date predicates, deleted=0, stable ordering, 20 events/day and 30 whole-day references. Sites clear-all remains a single guarded D1 mutation batch: revision CAS acquires write_token, privacy_revision increments, suppression time never decreases and includes greatest existing occurrence time, then scoped event/day deletion. New reader batching does not weaken these guards. Separate day-index and event reads are not a globally atomic snapshot.

Client and server project voice/assistant/reading/dictation to structural fields; personal reading is rejected. Existing vocabulary/writing callers use public IDs and fixed activity summaries. Migration erases automatic free text/private references, removes unedited personal-reading events, rekeys edited personal-reading identifiers, preserves explicit user edits, refreshes affected day facts and invalidates prior privacy contexts/queues. Quota DELETE/UPDATE triggers retain counters. Migration bytes exactly match Sites and must remain immutable.

Packaging checks clean reviewed source; rejects source symlinks/submodules and unexpected/private public/migration files; extracts an exact commit with Git replacement objects disabled into a private temporary directory; installs locked dependencies and builds there; accepts regular allowlisted output members only; verifies member names, uniqueness, type, size and SHA-256; rechecks source and atomically publishes the verified archive. No production source change requested.

Admission-valid shared request fixtures and action headers exercise precise 401/403 outcomes; GET origin behavior follows route contract. RSC/HTML positive controls and disabled multipart/action transport checks are explicit. Local workerd/D1 is disposable and provider egress is intercepted; new smoke checks structural journal privacy, personal-reading rejection, CAS clear and storage counters.

credentialAndPrivacyReview.scanMethod: Read every current changed/untracked file relative to f10737e; high-confidence credential/private-key/JWT/authenticated-URL patterns, email-domain classification, fixture and script source review. Counts describe this timestamp, not future logs. A scan cannot prove absence of every possible secret.
credentialAndPrivacyReview.credentialClassification: Deterministic local-worker encryption key, fake provider strings, fixture writeTokens and PRIVATE/QA markers are test data. No actual token, password, customer email or user document was found. A broad initial URL regex crossed adjacent quoted JS fields; the literal URL has no userinfo and the email is example.test.
credentialAndPrivacyReview.sitesArtifactVisualReview: All 10 added PNGs visually inspected: 6 browser screenshots match hardcoded fresh-context synthetic prompts/responses; 4 report pages contain technical evidence and these fixtures. PNG metadata is absent or DPI only. Both two-page PDFs have no author, no attachments, no catalog JavaScript/OpenAction/Launch and no credential-pattern match in extracted text.
credentialAndPrivacyReview.publicOperationalMetadata: Historical evidence contains site hostname, deployment/saved-version identifiers, source commits, a Codex Security run URL and local workspace paths. These are identifiers/provenance, not authentication secrets; no cookies, authenticated response bodies or private learner records are included.

measurementReview.httpModel: Production build through real local Node HTTP/workerd/D1, all response bytes consumed; 8 synthetic accounts and 46,800 historical vocabulary rows with actual quota triggers; 3 rounds at concurrency 1/4/12, 20 requests/client = 1,020 requests per version. Mix: 50% journal read, 20% memory read, 10% lexicon asset, 10% home, 10% journal write. Dense account is active at concurrency 12; five journal warmups excluded.
measurementReview.statistics: Nearest-rank percentiles on sorted raw request samples; aggregate percentiles must pool raw samples, not average per-round p95. Throughput uses completed requests divided by measured elapsed time. Preserve per-route values and all failures.
measurementReview.soak: Optional 12 concurrent readers; 120 seconds is a bounded local steady-state check, not production endurance. It omits concurrent writers/provider traffic and does not measure a production memory leak threshold.
measurementReview.toolboxMicrobenchmark: Only allowlisted immutable baseline content executes, replacement refs disabled. Four cases use alternating before/after order, 15 timing samples, 100 warm calls/sample and one cold call/sample; result-equivalence checks precede timing. It measures Node execution/result serialization, not HTTP/provider/UI response.
limitations: Closed-loop clients with no think time are a controlled saturation-like workload and incur coordinated omission; they do not establish open-loop arrival-rate capacity or true user concurrency.
Local workerd/D1 topology, synthetic histories and fresh isolated state exclude WAN, live identity gateway, real AI providers, physical mobile devices and production cache/distribution effects.
Three short rounds have no statistical confidence intervals; the five warmups cover one journal account, so full cache/JIT steady-state is not guaranteed.
CPU/total-memory fields can describe the host rather than container limits; final report must separately record effective resource limits.

All pre-merge and Sites historical timing/test counts are intermediate evidence only. Merged 2.19.4 needs fresh build/full tests/runtime/performance results under the same fixture and environment before delivery.
Historical browser fixtures use absolute runtime paths and trusted local base URLs; they are environment-specific QA scripts, not production code or portable CI requirements.
measurementReview.streamRenderComponent: Actual production React DOM/message/provenance components with a controlled context and synthetic 120-message history; counts 20 visible-answer updates and revalidates provenance on a word-map change. Synchronous commit timings exclude layout paint, complete app/network/provider work and INP. Three same-order rounds are corroborative; the deterministic historical-render count is the primary regression evidence.
